question: How are praiseworthiness and powerful animal forms attributed to the divine?
premises: The praiseworthy receives salutation as a divine form.
The lord of elephants receives salutation as a divine form.
The tiger receives salutation as a divine form.
inference: The divine is worthy of praise and manifests in powerful animal forms.
plain_english: Salutation to the praiseworthy, salutation to the lord of elephants, salutation to the tiger.
